cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this Microsoft Foundry video, which is part three, where we talk about agents.
cues.zh: 大家好，這是 Microsoft Foundry 系列第三部分，主題是代理程式。

cues.en: But before we do that, a small disclaimer, because Microsoft Foundry and the agent experience is still in preview [December 2025].
cues.zh: 開始前先說明，Microsoft Foundry 與代理程式體驗目前仍在預覽階段，這裡是 2025 年十二月。

cues.en: And honestly, it's quite buggy and half complete in various places, almost to the point where I didn't make this video.
cues.zh: 老實說，很多地方仍有錯誤或只做了一半，差一點讓我不想錄這支影片。

cues.en: So I will at the end of the video, after I explained how it should work and what works, I will explain a lot of the things that don't work and then
cues.zh: 所以最後在介紹應有行為與能用的部分之後，還會說明哪些功能不能用，

cues.en: talk a little about what we should do from here.
cues.zh: 再談談這個系列接下來怎麼進行。

cues.en: But let's first dive in and see what the claim is that we can do when this goes out of preview.
cues.zh: 不過先看，正式推出後它宣稱能做哪些事情。

cues.en: So in order to understand this best, I have put in a normal scenario, which is working with agents in memory, the old AI
cues.zh: 為了容易理解，我把一般記憶體代理程式的情境、舊版 AI，

cues.en: Foundry, classic agents, as they're called now, and this new Microsoft Foundry, and see them side by side in order for us to better
cues.zh: Foundry，也就是現在的 Classic Agents，以及新版 Microsoft Foundry 並排，

cues.en: understand what is new in Foundry, at least on paper.
cues.zh: 比較 Foundry 在設計上新增了什麼。

cues.en: So when you make a new agent, you, of course, just take the raw client, Azure OpenAI or OpenAI or similar.
cues.zh: 一般建立代理程式，先取得 Azure OpenAI、OpenAI 等原生用戶端。

cues.en: You do something similar in AI Foundry, but you do it using the azure.ai.agents .persistent NuGet package instead.
cues.zh: 舊版 AI Foundry 也類似，但改用 Azure.AI.Agents.Persistent NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And now in Microsoft Foundry, they have made yet another package.
cues.zh: 新版 Microsoft Foundry 又提供另一個套件，

cues.en: In this case, it's Microsoft Agents AI Azure AI.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Microsoft.Agents.AI.AzureAI。

cues.en: So, so far now, nothing special.
cues.zh: 目前為止沒有太特別。

cues.en: AI Foundry and Microsoft Foundry needs to do it using role-based access control.
cues.zh: AI Foundry 與 Microsoft Foundry 必須使用角色型存取控制。

cues.en: So you don't have an API key while you can choose up in normal systems.
cues.zh: 因此不像一般模型服務能選擇 API 金鑰。

cues.en: But here it begins to differ.
cues.zh: 接下來開始不同。

cues.en: In a normal scenario, you just create your agent in agent framework.
cues.zh: 一般情境直接在 Agent Framework 建立代理程式。

cues.en: You give it model, instruction, tools, and it all happens in memory.
cues.zh: 指定模型、指示、工具，全部留在記憶體。

cues.en: In AI Foundry, you create an agent as a persistent agent, meaning something where you create it, it's there, and then you can reference
cues.zh: AI Foundry 建立的是持續性代理程式，建立後會一直存在，之後可以，

cues.en: it later so you don't need to create it again and again.
cues.zh: 參照它，不需要每次重建。

cues.en: So the first time you create it, and then you use it after the fact by just referencing it.
cues.zh: 也就是第一次建立，之後直接依識別資料取得。

cues.en: So you only need to go and change the agent if you need to update something.
cues.zh: 只有需要更新內容時才修改。

cues.en: This is also the same for Microsoft Foundry, but can just do a little more.
cues.zh: Microsoft Foundry 也一樣，但多了一些能力。

cues.en: Because up here, we have model, tools, instructions, tools.
cues.zh: 前面主要提供模型、指示與工具。

cues.en: Down here, we have knowledge up front, which is vector stores that it can automatically search into and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 新版還能預先指定 Knowledge，例如可自動搜尋的向量儲存區。

cues.en: That's more a manual process up here.
cues.zh: 一般記憶體代理程式則要自己處理這些。

cues.en: In the new Foundry, you also have a new memory component where you can let it remember certain things about the user if you
cues.zh: 新版 Foundry 也有 Memory 元件，提供使用者範圍後，就能記住，

cues.en: give it the user scope, like what is their name, location, and such things.
cues.zh: 姓名、地點等資訊。

cues.en: A little like the AI provider context in agent framework.
cues.zh: 有點像 Agent Framework 的 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: And then again, we reference them by the existing name.
cues.zh: 之後同樣透過既有名稱取得。

cues.en: Up here, it's by ID.
cues.zh: 舊版使用 ID，

cues.en: Down here, it's by name.
cues.zh: 新版使用名稱。

cues.en: And it can also now work with versions, which I will get into in a bit.
cues.zh: 而且現在也能管理版本，稍後會說明。

cues.en: So on paper here, an even greater system than the AI Foundry.
cues.zh: 所以從設計上看，比舊版 AI Foundry 更完整。

cues.en: And the final part is, of course, consuming it up in a normal one.
cues.zh: 最後是使用方式；一般情境，

cues.en: You just consume the agent you just made in code.
cues.zh: 直接呼叫程式裡剛建立的代理程式。

cues.en: In AI Foundry, you either consume the agent you just made or got the reference to the agent, and then you used it.
cues.zh: AI Foundry 則使用剛建立的代理程式，或先取得參照再呼叫。

cues.en: And then on the fly, you could add more knowledge and more tools to the file.
cues.zh: 還能在執行時加入更多知識與工具。

cues.en: In Microsoft Foundry, this is completely changed in various different ways.
cues.zh: Microsoft Foundry 的使用方式則有許多變化。

cues.en: First up, all agents have a version.
cues.zh: 首先，所有代理程式都有版本。

cues.en: So you can now make a version 3, but still reference version 2, for example.
cues.zh: 例如可以建立第三版，但繼續使用第二版。

cues.en: So whenever you start here, you either need to...
cues.zh: 因此開始使用時，需要決定……

cues.en: If you don't specify, you just get the latest, but you can specify an earlier version.
cues.zh: 未指定版本，就會取最新；也可以明確指定舊版。

cues.en: I will show that in a live sample in just one second.
cues.zh: 稍後會在實際範例示範。

cues.en: And then you consume it, but the new system is that you should actually not do that.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫它，不過新版似乎不希望正式應用直接這樣使用。

cues.en: They're kind of vague on what you should do and what you shouldn't do.
cues.zh: 文件對建議與不建議的方式說得有點模糊。

cues.en: You can do it, but you can also publish an agent, meaning that it gets its own endpoint.
cues.zh: 可以直接呼叫，也能發布代理程式，讓它取得專屬端點。

cues.en: And the reason for that is that then your users should not know about your Foundry, and if you make a new version and
cues.zh: 原因是使用者不必知道你的 Foundry，而你建立新版本，

cues.en: you publish that, you can choose when it should be published to the user.
cues.zh: 並發布時，也能控制什麼時候讓使用者使用。

cues.en: So you can set and build, while here you can choose when to publish.
cues.zh: 也就是可以持續開發，再自行選擇發布時間。

cues.en: And these public versions can then be consumed by Agent Framework using the Responses API, or it can be consumed in Microsoft Teams and
cues.zh: 發布後能透過 Agent Framework 的 Responses API 使用，也能接到 Microsoft Teams，

cues.en: Microsoft 365.
cues.zh: 或 Microsoft 365。

cues.en: This is what the documentation and everything tells you what you can do and what's new.
cues.zh: 這些都是文件所描述的能力與新功能。

cues.en: And this is really exciting because it's a really good system and having these things.
cues.zh: 這很令人期待，因為整體設計相當完整。

cues.en: But a few things break down.
cues.zh: 但有些功能目前會出問題。

cues.en: I will show a little of them now in a live demo, and then we will talk a little about the rest of them after the fact.
cues.zh: 接著會在實際示範中看到一些，最後再討論其他限制。

cues.en: But let's jump in here.
cues.zh: 我們進入程式碼。

cues.en: And I have Microsoft Foundry here in my sample repo, which is linked in the description of this video.
cues.zh: 這裡是範例儲存庫的 Microsoft Foundry，連結放在影片說明。

cues.en: And I have a lot of old classic agents from the AI Foundry before.
cues.zh: 裡面有許多舊版 AI Foundry 的 Classic Agents 範例。

cues.en: And then I have this new one, Agents Basic.
cues.zh: 也有新版的 Agents Basic。

cues.en: And I made a basic one if we make more advanced stuff with tooling and stuff.
cues.zh: 先建立基本版本，之後也許再加工具等進階功能。

cues.en: And if we look at what we need in order to do this, we just need Azure Identity, and we need Azure AI package
cues.zh: 需要的套件只有 Azure.Identity，以及 Agent Framework 的 AzureAI，

cues.en: from the Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 套件。

cues.en: And up in the portal here, I don't have any agents right now.
cues.zh: 目前入口網站裡沒有任何代理程式。

cues.en: I could go in and make an agent and then just use it in code, so I don't need to build the agent in code if I don't want to.
cues.zh: 也可以直接在網站建立，再從程式使用，不一定要用程式建立。

cues.en: I could simply say, just create an agent,
cues.zh: 例如按 Create Agent，

cues.en: choose what model I want to use, write some instructions, add some tools, and then I could test it from here, or I could
cues.zh: 選擇模型、撰寫指示、加入工具，再直接在這裡測試，或，

cues.en: go in and use it in code just using the name test, because all agents in
cues.zh: 透過程式，以 Test 這個名稱取得，因為同一個，

cues.en: the same project needs to have a unique name.
cues.zh: 專案內的代理程式名稱必須唯一。

cues.en: I could then publish the agent.
cues.zh: 接著也可以發布代理程式。

cues.en: And when published, I will get some URLs.
cues.zh: 發布後會得到一些 URL。

cues.en: It takes a little extra time to publish today.
cues.zh: 今天發布稍微需要一點時間。

cues.en: And I could get an activity protocol that's for Microsoft Teams and the bot service and response API where I get that this URL
cues.zh: 可以取得供 Microsoft Teams 與 Bot Service 使用的 Activity Protocol，以及 Responses API；這個 URL，

cues.en: is specific to this agent, meaning the name is in the URL.
cues.zh: 專屬於這個代理程式，名稱包含在網址中。

cues.en: So everything can be done up from here.
cues.zh: 所以全部操作都能在網站完成。

cues.en: I could go in and say I want the code interpreter tool, and then it would know the code interpreter tool and so on.
cues.zh: 例如加入 Code Interpreter 工具，之後代理程式就能使用。

cues.en: But I can also make them in code.
cues.zh: 不過也可以用程式建立。

cues.en: And you can see I actually saved it twice, one when I published and the other when I added the code interpreter tool.
cues.zh: 可以看到我其實儲存了兩次，一次是發布，另一次是加入 Code Interpreter。

cues.en: So now I have two versions, by the way.
cues.zh: 因此現在已有兩個版本。

cues.en: And I can go back to version 1 where I didn't have the tool.
cues.zh: 也能切回沒有工具的第一版。

cues.en: So pretty neat that you can do it up here.
cues.zh: 這樣操作很方便。

cues.en: Of course, it's all about normal resources.
cues.zh: 當然，這些都只是一般資源。

cues.en: This infrastructure as code probably would be best if we made the agents in code, and they will auto-create themselves if someone goes
cues.zh: 如果採基礎結構即程式碼，可能更適合用程式建立；萬一有人，

cues.en: and, by mistake, delete the agent up here.
cues.zh: 誤刪網站中的代理程式，就能自動重建。

cues.en: But that's all a matter of opinion.
cues.zh: 這就看個人選擇。

cues.en: Let's see it in code at least.
cues.zh: 至少來看程式寫法。

cues.en: So if we run the code, we will just take it line by line.
cues.zh: 執行後逐行說明。

cues.en: So first we make something called an AI project client.
cues.zh: 首先建立 AIProjectClient。

cues.en: Let me just move it down here.
cues.zh: 先把畫面移到下方。

cues.en: And this comes from this Azure AI project.
cues.zh: 它來自 Azure.AI.Projects。

cues.en: And then there's another subfolder for OpenAI, which is kind of silly now that Claude can be used as tools.
cues.zh: 另外還有 OpenAI 子命名空間，現在 Claude 也能用，名稱就顯得有點奇怪。

cues.en: So we are using technically a namespace called projects.openai to work with Claude as well.
cues.zh: 也就是說，要操作 Claude，技術上也會使用 Projects.OpenAI。

cues.en: But we have done that for ages with the Azure OpenAI tool that can run Mistral and all the other models anyway.
cues.zh: 不過 Azure OpenAI 套件早就能呼叫 Mistral 等其他模型，也不是第一次。

cues.en: In any case, we have the AI project client where we just give an endpoint and our Azure CLI credentials.
cues.zh: 總之，建立 AIProjectClient，提供端點與 Azure CLI 憑證。

cues.en: In my case, I set up Azure CLI.
cues.zh: 我自己已經設定 Azure CLI。

cues.en: Let me find it up here.
cues.zh: 找到上方這個，

cues.en: There's the AZ tool where I've logged in.
cues.zh: 就是已經登入的 az 工具。

cues.en: And that will give me my credentials.
cues.zh: 它會提供憑證。

cues.en: Up in Azure, of course, they are given by the tool and the managed identities.
cues.zh: 在 Azure 上，通常改用受控識別。

cues.en: And here you could use default Azure credentials in order to get them from the Visual Studio and stuff instead.
cues.zh: 本機也可以用 DefaultAzureCredential，從 Visual Studio 等地方取得登入資訊。

cues.en: But I just use this because it's the fastest one, despite it being slow.
cues.zh: 我用 CLI 是因為相對最快，雖然仍然不算快。

cues.en: Then if we want to make an agent, we, of course, need the model.
cues.zh: 接著若要建立代理程式，當然需要模型。

cues.en: And this client can actually also work with the deployments.
cues.zh: 這個用戶端也能操作部署資訊。

cues.en: It can list the deployments, but unfortunately, it can't create the deployments.
cues.zh: 可以列出部署，但可惜不能建立部署。

cues.en: So we couldn't go from just having a project to getting the model deployed and up and running.
cues.zh: 所以無法從只有專案的狀態，直接把模型部署好。

cues.en: But at least we can check if our model exists.
cues.zh: 至少仍然可以檢查模型是否存在。

cues.en: I'm doing it with a try-catch method here, but I could also just list all deployments and then loop through, is there a deployment called dbt-41-mini.
cues.zh: 這裡用 try-catch，也可以列出所有部署，再尋找 GPT-4.1 mini。

cues.en: In my case, it exists, so I don't get this error, but else I would get the error.
cues.zh: 我的部署存在，所以不會出錯；沒有的話就會收到錯誤。

cues.en: And in my case, I would just write out that it wasn't found.
cues.zh: 這個範例只輸出找不到模型。

cues.en: I do this similar with the agents, where I just ask for the agent by name.
cues.zh: 代理程式也用類似方式，先依名稱查詢。

cues.en: And if that fails, which it will, because we don't have it, we get a 404.
cues.zh: 因為目前沒有，所以會收到 404。

cues.en: And we will just say, okay, the agent doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 我們就知道代理程式不存在，

cues.en: Let's create it.
cues.zh: 接著建立它。

cues.en: And in my case, I'm sending in the instructions here, because I later on want to make a version 2 with other instructions.
cues.zh: 這裡把指示當成參數傳入，因為稍後想建立使用不同指示的第二版。

cues.en: And in this case, it was urnici.
cues.zh: 這次只要求它是一個友善的 AI。

cues.en: And then we use the client.agents.createAgentVersion.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 Client.Agents.CreateAgentVersion。

cues.en: So we always make versions instead of agents, because the first time it will just be version 1.
cues.zh: 也就是一律建立版本，而不是直接建立代理程式；第一次自然就是第一版。

cues.en: We don't specify the version or anything.
cues.zh: 不需要自行指定版本號。

cues.en: That just happens automatically.
cues.zh: 系統會自動處理。

cues.en: So in order to create an agent, we need a name, and we need to give it some options in terms of agent version creation options.
cues.zh: 建立時需要名稱，以及 AgentVersionCreationOptions。

cues.en: And there's various different agent versions, some being hosted, some being file-based, image-based, and
cues.zh: 代理程式定義有不同種類，例如 Hosted、檔案或圖片相關版本，

cues.en: so on.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: But we want a prompt agent definition, meaning a normal agent.
cues.zh: 這裡要的是 PromptAgentDefinition，也就是一般代理程式。

cues.en: I haven't seen what the others can be used for at the moment, so it might be for some future projects or something I haven't noticed in the system.
cues.zh: 目前還沒研究其他型別的用途，也許是未來功能，或是我還沒注意到的部分。

cues.en: But if we make this, let me just make it so we can see the code.
cues.zh: 建立時，先讓畫面顯示完整程式碼，

cues.en: We can give tools in here.
cues.zh: 可以在這裡提供工具。

cues.en: So we give tools, for example.
cues.zh: 例如加入工具，

cues.en: And if we want to make a code interpreter tool, like OpenAI have it, we can do that.
cues.zh: 像 OpenAI 的 Code Interpreter。

cues.en: We need to tell what container that should be in, and we can make it create an automatic container so we don't need to do anything.
cues.zh: 必須指定使用哪個容器，也能選自動建立，就不必自己處理。

cues.en: This is a little more cumbersome than the old Azure AI Foundry, where we just told it code interpreter tools, but it's because it
cues.zh: 這比舊版 Azure AI Foundry 只說要 Code Interpreter 稍微繁瑣，原因是，

cues.en: can also hook up to existing containers so it doesn't need to spin them up.
cues.zh: 現在也能連到既有容器，不必每次重新啟動。

cues.en: In our case, we just do that.
cues.zh: 這裡使用自動容器。

cues.en: We can also give it web search, which is fine.
cues.zh: 也可以提供網頁搜尋，這沒有問題。

cues.en: And you can technically give MCP tools, but this is one of the buggy things that are right now, in that we can make
cues.zh: 技術上也能提供 MCP，但這是目前其中一個有問題的功能；雖然可以建立，

cues.en: a tool, meaning a remote MCP tool, but if we do that, it will just call
cues.zh: 遠端 MCP 工具，使用後卻只會開始呼叫，

cues.en: it but never complete it because built into the portal is that it needs approval for MCP tools, and Agent Framework can't handle that
cues.zh: 永遠不完成，因為入口網站預設 MCP 工具需要核准，而 Agent Framework 目前無法處理，

cues.en: approval process right now.
cues.zh: 這個核准流程。

cues.en: So that's the reason I've taken it away, but else it's just a name and a URL, which also is a bit buggy in my mind because if you had a remote
cues.zh: 因此我把它移除了；原本只要名稱與 URL，但這也有問題，因為如果遠端，

cues.en: MCP tool that needed an API key in its headers, you wouldn't be able to give that through this agent NuGet package right now.
cues.zh: MCP 需要在標頭中帶 API 金鑰，目前這個 NuGet 套件沒有地方設定。

cues.en: Moving on, we can do instructions.
cues.zh: 接著是 Instructions。

cues.en: We have talked about that.
cues.zh: 前面已經介紹過。

cues.en: And there's also options for reasoning options, but this is also buggy at the moment, so if you set them, the portal will completely
cues.zh: 另外還有 ReasoningOptions，但目前也有問題；設定後入口網站會完全，

cues.en: ignore it, set every model to high for some reason, even though the default is medium,
cues.zh: 忽略，莫名把模型設為 High，雖然預設應該是 Medium。

cues.en: and if you try to set it like this, it will not recognise it, and it will ask every time you do anything to
cues.zh: 如果像這樣設定，網站又認不出來，每次操作代理程式都會說，

cues.en: an agent, hey, it's unsaved because it looks at the behind-the-scenes data and that's different from what it sees itself.
cues.zh: 有未儲存變更，因為底層資料與網站認知的設定不同。

cues.en: So right now, effectively, we can't set the reasoning, which is a huge bug in my opinion.
cues.zh: 因此目前實際上無法正常設定推理強度，我認為這是很大的問題。

cues.en: The old portal also has it, unfortunately.
cues.zh: 可惜舊版入口網站也有。

cues.en: There's also file search tools and such things, but these were just a simple one to set up.
